steps.step: GM1 toy (D = 20, Gaussian prior, radial weight e^{a |phi|}): the multiplicative amplitude move WITH the Jacobian s^D reproduces the exact <|phi|^2>; without the Jacobian it is biased
GM2 toy: pCN on a 3-dimensional subspace (prior exact) with a weight e^{b . c} reproduces the exact shifted subspace mean b sigma^2

GM3 production code path (debug4, g = 1e-4): with amplitude and pCN moves the field norm follows the prior <|phi|^2> = D 2 g dtau and both moves are accepted (bitwise invariance with global_moves = None: sector_envelope.py ES2)
GM5 production code path (debug4, g = 1e-4): pCN on the 10 uniform (K = 0, omega = 0) channel modes keeps the prior variance of the uniform coordinates and is accepted

GM6 production code path (debug4, g = 1e-4): the multiplicative move of the 10 uniform coordinates with the Jacobian s^10 keeps their prior distribution, <|c_u|^2> / sigma^2 = 10 (chi^2_10), and is accepted
GM4 (statement) benchmark at g = 0.021, beta = 4, lambda = 0.35: plateau of |phi|^2 and G(beta/2) with and without global moves
